rationale_overall: Held the 2-slot watchlist (MSFT, NVDA) unchanged. NVDA absorbed real dated headwinds (Aug 26 2022 Commerce license requirement blocking A100/H100 exports to China, ~$400M Q3 risk; Q2 FY23 gaming revenue down 44% QoQ with a $1.32B inventory charge) but its Data Center segment still grew 61% YoY, so the AI thesis is pressured not breached, and the stock is well off any peak — neither removal guardrail is cleanly met. MSFT's cloud franchise (Azure +46%) reinforces the anchor. Pass-1 surfaced genuine defense (Raytheon NASAMS/Ukraine) and tanker buildup signals, but with the cap at 2 and no clean NVDA removal, adding would require displacing an AI anchor on weak grounds. Deferring.
